text:
maria-sales: Heads-up — Quant Industries wants to close this week. They sent back the order form with DPA/MSA redlines, asking for Net45, bank-wire payment option, and a multi-signer flow (POC will be signed by procurement + legal). Any blockers on our side? Link to docs: https://drive.internal/quant/orderform.pdf

aj-pre-sales: Thanks — can you paste the key redlines? I need to call the customer. Are they requesting any SLA changes or increased data residency?

maria-sales: Key asks: net45 payment terms, add bank wiring details on invoice, remove the default 30-day termination notice (they want immediate termination for breach), DPA changes around subprocessor list and 90-day breach notice. No specific residency ask, but they want HSM/KMS mention.

neal-legal: Quick notes from a legal POV: Net45 is unusual for our standard T&Cs but doable with finance sign-off. We should not remove the 30-day cure period entirely — propose reducing to 10 days for material breach instead of immediate termination. For DPA, limit their requested subprocessor clause by committing to provide list within 30 days and 30-day notice for new subprocessors. HSM/KMS: we can offer a KMS integration option (customer-managed key) as an add-on.

emma-ops: Regarding multi-signer flow — our standard DocuSign template supports parallel signers but requires template change. Ops can enable a multi-signer envelope for this customer, but we need the signer emails and an exception ticket for the template change (1 business day). Also bank wiring: we can add a wire-payments appendix with our banking details. We cannot host bank details on the public order form; it'll be an invoice appendix.

ryan-procurement: For PO processing: we need their vendor code and remit-to address. Net45 requires an AP-approved exception. Who owns AP-approval? Also confirm whether they will provide a PO number at signature or after.

maria-sales: They've said PO will be attached at signature. @ryan-procurement can you start the vendor onboarding checklist? I can push for PO at signing.

neal-legal: Suggested redline language (short):
```
- Payment: "Customer shall pay invoices Net45 days from receipt. Exceptions require Finance approval."
- Termination: "For material breach, the non-breaching party may terminate if breach is not cured within 10 days after written notice."
- Subprocessors: "Provider will maintain an up-to-date list of subprocessors and provide notice 30 days prior to onboarding new subprocessors."
```
This keeps us safe and addresses their asks.

emma-ops: Action: I'll file a template-exception ticket and enable parallel signing. Need signer list and exact emails. ETA: 24 hours once I have that.

ryan-procurement: I'll kick off vendor onboarding. Ask to confirm remit-to + whether they require invoice to reference PO before payment.

maria-sales: Customer contacts: legal@quantindustries.com (legal), ap@quantindustries.com (billing). I'll request signer names now.

esign-bot: Envelope created for Quant Industries order form (env_805322). Current status: draft.

aj-pre-sales: One more thing — pricing: are we offering quant discounts for POC scale? They asked about committed usage to get lower unit price. I'll share the proposed commit in this thread later.

maria-sales: Great. Next steps: @neal-legal to produce a short redline and confirm final wording; @emma-ops to queue the DocuSign exception; @ryan-procurement to start vendor onboarding; @aj-pre-sales to finalize commit pricing. I'll loop back with signer emails. :thumbsup:

neal-legal: Acknowledged — will post the redline by EOD.

emma-ops: Acknowledged — filing exception now.

maria-sales: Thanks team — keeping this high priority.
